text: Single file scheduler.py, Python stdlib only
Job id: alphanumeric and underscore, 1-32 chars; invalid ids rejected
Job ids unique; duplicate id rejected on add
Job has name, priority 1-10 (out-of-range rejected), depends_on list of ids
Reject any add that would create a cycle
Execution order is topological with higher priority first as tiebreak
Job is ready when pending and all depends_on are done
Failing a job cancels all transitive dependents
Status values limited to pending, ready, running, done, failed, cancelled
run-next takes highest-priority ready job, marks it running then done
run-next with no ready job handled gracefully
Commands add, run-next, fail <id>, status, report exist
fail on unknown id rejected with error
Errors reported with nonzero exit code, state unchanged on rejected add
